name: Channel strip
author: hundekraft
description: The channel strip shapes the synth and the drums before the tape, like the channel on a mixing desk. It sits before their effect, or after it if you like. There's one strip for the synth, one for the drums and a MASTER strip for everything you hear. They stay as they are when you change sounds or kits, and they are kept after a restart. They all start switched off, so nothing changes until you turn one on: hold Shift and turn green right.
